# PVA Bazaar

PVA Bazaar is a public pure-life knowledge marketplace and business bridge.
It combines commerce, provenance, archive writing, publishing, continuity tools, and institutional partnership pages.

Site URL: https://pvabazaar.org/
Sitemap: https://pvabazaar.org/sitemap.xml
Readable JSON: https://pvabazaar.org/readable-site.json
Status page: https://pvabazaar.org/status.html

Public surfaces:

- Get Started: https://pvabazaar.org/get-started.html
- Marketplace: https://pvabazaar.org/marketplace.html
- Archive: https://pvabazaar.org/archive.html
- Writings: https://pvabazaar.org/writings.html
- Books: https://pvabazaar.org/books.html
- Published Books: https://pvabazaar.org/#/books/published

Legacy compatibility redirects:

- /pages/portfolio.html -> /portfolio.html

Notes for fetchers:
1. Start with this file for a short summary.
2. Use readable-site.json for structured route metadata.
3. Static HTML fallback pages exist for direct browser access without JavaScript.
4. Private account surfaces require authentication.
